ShopLedger Work in progress

A retail-operations product concept for shops, marts, malls and small businesses. The planned app will help merchants organise products, prices, sales records, receipts, expenses and everyday store operations.

The multi-tenant architecture and access controls are being designed carefully so each shop remains isolated from every other shop’s records.

About Pamilerin

A builder who thinks beyond the build.

I’m a technology, product and brand strategist from Nigeria. I build and document digital products while exploring how technology, content, SEO, positioning and business thinking can work together.

My technical background helps me understand what can be shipped. My product and brand work keeps asking the harder questions: what is worth building, who needs it, how will they find it and what value should it create?
